programDetail.overviewTemplate: {{title}} at {{universityName}} combines {{focus}} with {{style}}. The program is shaped to build strong practical skills and clear career direction.
programDetail.studyModeTemplate: {{level}} partners include industry labs, research centers, and local employers

1.name: Technical University
1.description: Leading engineering and technology programs with state-of-the-art research facilities.
1.longDescription: Technical University of Varna is the second-largest state technical university in Bulgaria. It holds institutional accreditation with the highest rating of Very Good for a six-year period, awarded by the National Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (NEAA). Furthermore, it is the first university in Bulgaria to receive institutional accreditation from the European University Association. The university maintains a high standard of education, certified under ISO 9001:2008, and boasts an extensive international network with mutual cooperation agreements with over 120 foreign universities.

2.name: Medical University
2.description: World-class medical education with top-ranked clinical training programs.
2.longDescription: The Medical University of Varna is a leading institution in Bulgarian medical education, known for its high-quality clinical training and research programs.

3.name: Economics University
3.description: Premier business and economics programs shaping future leaders.
3.longDescription: The Economics University of Varna is a leading institution in Bulgarian economic education, known for its comprehensive programs and research initiatives.

4.name: Naval University
4.description: Pioneering maritime intelligence: Specialized education and research for a global industry.
4.longDescription: The Naval University of Varna is a leading institution in Bulgarian maritime education, known for its specialized programs and research initiatives.

5.name: Free University
5.description: Specialized maritime education with cutting-edge naval research and training.
5.longDescription: The Free University of Varna is a leading institution in Bulgarian maritime education, known for its specialized programs and research initiatives.

6.name: University of Management
6.description: Where theory meets practice: Shaping the next generation of global business and tourism leaders.
6.longDescription: The University of Management of Varna is a leading institution in Bulgarian business education, known for its comprehensive programs and research initiatives.

1.name: Technical University
1.focus: engineering, automation, computing, renewable energy, and industrial systems
1.style: hands-on labs, applied research, and strong industry links
admissionNotes: Portfolio or interview may help for design-focused tracks

2.name: Medical University
2.focus: clinical training, health sciences, and patient-centered practice
2.style: hospital placements, simulation labs, and research-based learning
admissionNotes: Competitive tracks may include entrance exams or interviews

3.name: Economics University
3.focus: business strategy, finance, accounting, economics, and market analysis
3.style: case studies, analytics, and practical business projects
admissionNotes: Useful for students with interest in math and business

4.name: Naval University
4.focus: maritime operations, navigation, ship systems, and port logistics
4.style: simulators, sea-focused practice, and technical training
admissionNotes: Best suited to students who enjoy technical and operational work
Safety and discipline are core parts of the training

5.name: Free University
5.focus: international relations, public administration, and business-oriented studies
5.style: discussion-led seminars, policy analysis, and applied projects
admissionNotes: Good communication and research skills are important
Group work is a major part of the study experience

6.name: University of Management
6.focus: tourism, hospitality, event planning, and digital business management
6.style: practice-based learning, business cases, and service-industry projects
admissionNotes: Helpful for students interested in leadership and customer experience
Strong biology and chemistry background is useful
Practical experience matters in this field

business.keyFocus: business analysis, leadership, and strategic decision-making
admissionNotes: Math, communication, and problem-solving help a lot

maritime.keyFocus: maritime systems, transport operations, and technical control
admissionNotes: Comfort with technical and operational work is important
Field practice is a core part of training

tech.keyFocus: digital systems, coding, automation, and applied technology
admissionNotes: Projects and labs usually matter more than memorization

engineering.keyFocus: engineering design, applied science, and technical problem solving
admissionNotes: Math and physics are usually important
Practical projects are central to the course

general.keyFocus: specialized academic development and practical skill building
admissionNotes: Check the exact entrance requirements for this track
Project work and steady performance are important

4:bachelor:navigation-ship-maneuvering.overview: Navigation (Ship Maneuvering) at TU–Varna combines theoretical navigation with mandatory simulator training and sea practice complying with STCW conventions.
4:bachelor:navigation-ship-maneuvering.keyFocus: Practical seamanship, navigation safety, and maritime operations
admissionNotes: Program includes mandatory simulator and sea practice components
Contact the department for certification and training schedules

6:bachelor:software-systems-and-technolo.overview: Software Systems and Technologies (BSc Hons) at VUM is a Cardiff Met dual-award programme combining software engineering fundamentals with industry-aligned internships and practical projects.
6:bachelor:software-systems-and-technolo.keyFocus: Software development, algorithms, systems design and applied industry practice
6:bachelor:software-systems-and-technolo.duration: Full-time (3 years typical; 3 / 3.5 / 4 year options with APL)
highlights: Modular ECTS structure with downloadable curriculum
admissionNotes: English language requirements and APL pathways apply

6:master:master-of-business-administrati.overview: The MBA at VUM is an international, Cardiff Met–validated programme focused on management, strategic leadership and applied business practice.
6:master:master-of-business-administrati.keyFocus: Strategic management, finance, marketing and leadership
highlights: Dual award MBA with Cardiff Met
Dissertation (15 ECTS) and core modules totalling ~90 ECTS
Mobile student networks and international mobility opportunities
admissionNotes: Requires a relevant bachelor degree or equivalent professional experience
Check Cardiff Met admission alignment for postgraduate entry requirements

5:bachelor:business-administration.overview: The BBA at Free University of Varna develops practical management and business skills for international careers.
5:bachelor:business-administration.keyFocus: Management, entrepreneurship, and applied business practice
admissionNotes: Check the university admission pages for entry requirements
English-track intake available for international applicants

5:bachelor:international-relations.overview: A BA in International Relations at Free University covers diplomacy, policy analysis and international organisations.
5:bachelor:international-relations.keyFocus: Diplomacy, policy analysis and global affairs
highlights: Opportunities for internships in NGOs and public bodies
admissionNotes: Strong writing and research skills are useful
Check specific document requirements on the university site

5:bachelor:public-administration.overview: The BA in Public Administration prepares students for careers in public sector management and policy implementation.

5:bachelor:european-studies.overview: European Studies focuses on the institutions, law and policy of the EU and its role in global affairs.
5:bachelor:european-studies.keyFocus: EU institutions, law and comparative policy

6:bachelor:tourism-management.overview: The BSc Tourism Management at University of Management focuses on tourism operations, strategy and destination marketing.
6:bachelor:tourism-management.keyFocus: Tourism operations, destination management and service design
admissionNotes: Work experience and language skills are an advantage

6:bachelor:hotel-management.overview: Hotel Management trains students in hospitality operations, service management and revenue optimisation.
6:bachelor:hotel-management.keyFocus: Hospitality operations, service excellence and management
admissionNotes: Practical placement is part of the curriculum
Check language requirements for international tracks

6:bachelor:event-management.overview: Event Management provides skills in planning, logistics and promotion of events and conferences.
admissionNotes: Portfolio of event work or related experience can help
Check programme details for placement requirements

6:bachelor:digital-marketing.overview: Digital Marketing trains students in online marketing, analytics and campaign management.
6:bachelor:digital-marketing.keyFocus: Digital channels, analytics and content strategy
admissionNotes: Prior marketing interest or portfolio useful
